Blocks.Section: SSO Configuration
SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text: Enabling SAML SSO:

Blocks.Section: SSO Configuration
SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text: • LinkedIn Learning recommends SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. SSO authentication can be configured in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most organizations have a centrally managed identity management solution like Azure AD, Okta or AD FS which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise applications like LinkedIn Learning.

Blocks.Section: SSO Configuration
SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Blocks.Text: • To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

Blocks.Section: Automated Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Automated Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: The LinkedIn Learning library contains thousands of courses. LinkedIn Learning adds courses at a rate of 20-30 per week at no extra cost.

Blocks.Section: Automated Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Automated Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: Darwinbox automates this process using the LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, Darwinbox will dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of release. All content titles and descriptions are aggregated and indexed to accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability within Darwinbox.

Blocks.Section: Reporting
SectionPath: SSO Configuration
Reporting
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage
reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In
addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses xAPI to communicate a
learner’s activity back to Darwinbox when the learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course. All LinkedIn Learning course completions will be reported both in LinkedIn Learning and in Darwinbox.

Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: For Darwinbox to sync LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata, API keys must be provisioned in LinkedIn Learning admin settings.

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text: To sync your Darwinbox content with LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Login to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Me > Integrate





From the side navigation menu, Access content and reports via API.





Click the down arrow on the right to expand the Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application section.

Click Add Application and provide the name related to your LMS (e.g., "Darwinbox LMS Integration"), as the application name, and provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field.





There are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select the fields that apply to you. For Content Sync to the LMS, only Content is required.

Click Next and agree to the Terms and Conditions

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values.
